sessions.phase_label: Association bylaws purpose review and requirements clarification

requirements.title: Charitable Purpose Wording
requirements.definition: Revise the association's purpose clause in §2 so that each retained charitable purpose uses wording aligned with the applicable purposes in §52 AO.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection and legally aligned wording of the charitable purposes; concrete activities and their assignment to each purpose belong to the separate purpose-to-measure mapping Requirement.

requirements.title: Purpose-to-Measure Mapping
requirements.definition: Describe concrete measures in §2 for every retained charitable purpose, including how the association will carry them out directly, so a third party and the tax office can assess compliance.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently assessable mapping of each purpose to concrete implementation measures; it excludes selection and statutory wording of the purposes themselves.

unresolved_candidates.description: The visible history does not conclusively establish whether the revised clause should retain all three discussed purposes—art and culture, education, and public and vocational training—or only art and culture.
The association's concrete activities and externally emailed files are not present in the supplied history, so the specific measures to be written into the clause cannot yet be determined.
